name: varvig
description: Varvig MCP gate — a scoped, propose-only source-control gate for agents. Reads are logged into provenance; the gate can create proposals but never promote a ref.
long_description: The Varvig MCP gate exposes a single task's read set to an agent over stdio: fetch trees, blobs, changes and provenance evidence within a scope, and propose signed, speculative changes. Every proposal is append-only and human-gated for promotion. This bundle embeds the varvig binary for one platform; the version is stamped at release time and pinned by the varvig-tools marketplace.

tools.name: fetch_tree
tools.description: List a directory within the task's scope.

tools.name: fetch_blob
tools.description: Read a file's contents within the task's scope.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List this task's proposed, un-promoted changes.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Propose a signed, speculative change; never promotes a ref.
